root: library/ (paths are relative to this folder)
sampler_limits: <=64 regions, one sample per key range, no velocity layers/round robins

instruments.name: Electric Guitar Chords (Emilyguitar)
instruments.notes: Each note plays a whole barre chord on that root, so write one note per chord. Keyswitch notes (silent) pick the chord type: 33 power chord (default), 34 minor, 35 major.

instruments.name: Electric Guitar Chords Wide (Emilyguitar)
instruments.notes: Stereo-spread version of Electric Guitar Chords. One note per chord; keyswitches 33 power (default), 34 minor, 35 major.

instruments.name: Electric Guitar Three Voice (Emilyguitar)
instruments.notes: Three takes of each note at once: a thick double-tracked sound.

instruments.name: Electric Guitar Five Voice (Emilyguitar)
instruments.notes: Five layered voices per note: a huge wall-of-guitar sound.
